historical_reviews.deepseek: Cannot attribute a generic memory error to a physical slot or prove all-slot coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds UMC mapping and health gates but does not resolve how the command selects each slot, whether 1.1/1.2 are alternative modes, or whether 0x1000 is valid mapped DRAM.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row 43 reuses the command for non-fatal UCE and adds restart behavior; its severity/recovery must remain separate.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Slot coverage requires address-to-UMC/channel/DIMM/rank mapping and distinct evidence; literal low addresses and profile ambiguity may not be guessed.

original_test_intent: Verify correctable DRAM ECC handling for every required populated memory slot, with an attributable UMC/channel/DIMM/rank event, preserved memory service and restored RAS configuration.
original_method: Inventory populated DIMMs and decode the platform address map; decide whether DRAM and MCA settings are separate approved profiles or a sequence; select a safe backed test page for each slot rather than assuming physical 0x1000; run one operator-controlled CE per mapped target; correlate tool output, MCA/EDAC/APEI or WHEA, rasdaemon and BMC/UEFI slot identity; validate memory/link health and restore BIOS/HDT/injection state.
manual_activity: The FAE defines profile semantics, maps safe test addresses to each physical slot, provisions HDT/tool, performs one CE per approved target and restores all state; the agent only collects and correlates read-only evidence.
required_inputs: Decision whether DRAM 1.1 and MCA 1.2 are alternatives, separate checkpoints or cumulative settings
AMD tool/spec version/hash/license and `--listvalidumc`, address/mask, mcapolling and errortype semantics
Safe reserved/backed address per target; proof 0x1000 is valid or replacement rule
Required slot 1~N coverage and exact CE MCA/EDAC/APEI/WHEA/rasdaemon/BMC identity oracle
Timeout, counter behavior, BIOS FFFE/FFE deviations, abort/recovery/restoration
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT with ECC RDIMMs, backup, OOB console and memory recovery
Never inject at 0x1000 or another address until it is mapped to owned backed DRAM and not firmware/MMIO/reserved space
Apply only one approved BIOS profile and record original/target/restored values
One mapped CE per target; stop on wrong slot, UCE escalation, reset, storm, persistent poison or memory-health degradation
No automatic retry; disable injection and verify post-test memory integrity
agent_execution_scope: Validate inventory/address map, tool provenance, profile decision, oracle and recovery readiness
Collect read-only SMBIOS/EDAC/rasdaemon/MCA/WHEA/BMC and post-health evidence
Do not select address/profile, change BIOS/HDT, inject, broaden slot coverage, retry/recover automatically or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve slot-address map and all required targets
Resolve DRAM versus MCA profile sequencing and exact command semantics
Define per-slot evidence, timeout, abort and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: dmesg and rasdaemon can confirm a memory event but cannot map a fixed address to Memory slot 1~N or resolve Windows evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each approved slot, inject once at a reserved address proven by the platform decoder to belong to that DIMM/rank, using the approved profile and preserving complete tool and decoded event evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal 0x1000/mask/mcapolling/errortype command, both BIOS profiles, slot 1~N intent and 60/60-minute estimate are preserved as source; unsafe or ambiguous values are not assumed executable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an authoritative address-to-slot decoder and reserved pages to create one attributable CE checkpoint per required populated slot under a single defined RAS profile.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds slot inventory, safe page ownership, profile separation, event decoding, Windows evidence, bounded timeout and restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One event at unmapped address 0x1000 cannot demonstrate Memory slot 1~N, even if the tool returns PASS.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong address or profile may touch reserved memory, target the wrong DIMM, create persistent poison, reset the host or mask the event.

project_override_considerations: If the tool internally remaps address 0x1000 through a selected UMC, the exact selection mechanism and slot iteration must be documented. Otherwise the row needs an execution package that supplies per-slot safe addresses without changing Master.
expected_evidence: Exact identity and full DIMM/topology inventory
Approved profile decision and before/target/after BIOS/HDT values
Tool/spec provenance, valid-UMC output and address-to-slot proof for every target
Per-slot command transcript and attributable CE OS/rasdaemon/BMC record within timeout
Injection disablement, restoration and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires Memory slot 1~N, but the sole command has one fixed address and no UMC/slot selector despite listing valid UMCs. DRAM and MCA profiles contradict on corrected-counter enable and are not identified as alternatives or sequence. Timeout is undefined and Windows is listed while Criteria requires dmesg.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The per-slot correctable-memory intent is clear. Engineering can provide the address map, profile choice and oracle, so static review completes while execution remains gated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row 42 Wistron-System RAS-00762-V003: provide the populated socket/UMC/channel/subchannel/DIMM/rank/slot map and safe reserved address per required slot; decide whether DRAM 1.1 and MCA 1.2 profiles are alternatives, separate checkpoints or cumulative; approve AMD tool/spec version/hash/license, address/mask/mcapolling/errortype semantics, per-slot CE Linux/Windows/BMC oracle, timeout, BIOS threshold deviations, aborts, recovery and restoration.

review_improvement: Prevents one unmapped low address and ambiguous BIOS profiles from being counted as complete slot 1~N coverage, and makes every CE attributable to a physical DIMM target.
independent_technical_reasoning: A DRAM injection address is only a slot selector after platform address decoding accounts for interleave, hashing, socket, UMC, channel, rank and reserved ranges. Address 0x1000 is especially unsafe to assume because it may not be a normal owned test page. The two source profiles disagree about corrected-counter mode, so applying both blindly changes the mechanism being tested. Tool PASS reports injector handling, not which slot logged or whether memory stayed healthy.
